description: Three signal delays, each holding its input back by a whole number of samples, up to five

params.text: Sets how many samples that row's signal is held back by, 0 to 5

inputs.text: The signal to be delayed on the first row
The signal to be delayed on that row; with nothing patched it takes whatever is arriving at the row above

outputs.text: The row's signal, delayed by the number of samples its knob sets

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack above it.
